**Unofficial, use at your own risk.** iGreenLight is not affiliated with Microsoft or Xbox. It signs in with the
client ID of Microsoft's own Xbox app, Microsoft may block it at any time, and using an unofficial client may be
against the terms of your account.

### Installing on iPhone or iPad

The `.ipa` is **unsigned**: it will not install by itself. Install it with a sideloading tool that signs it with
your own Apple ID, such as AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. See
[Installing on iPhone or iPad](https://github.com/andreencar/iGreenLight#installing-on-iphone-or-ipad) in the README.

Requires iOS 18 or later. There is no Mac download; build the Mac app from source.

The licences of the software inside the app are shown under Settings → About.
